one_line: A trained neural controller (context->P(a|c), MLP+Adam, GPU) minimizing the rational-inattention objective E[U]-beta*I(C;A) converges to the analytic value-of-information rate function V*(I) across all seeds/prices, and exhibits the predicted phase transition (critical problem routes, regular one abstains).
caveats: This is a demonstration that a learning system REALISES a KNOWN analytic fixed point V*(R); it is a fit-to-optimum convergence result, NOT an independent empirical prediction.
EXPLORATORY: no separately-committed preregistration precedes this run; it is a theory->learning-system bridge, not a confirmatory claim.
It is deliberately NOT a claim_registry.json entry and is NOT part of the L0..L8 claim ladder.
It is NOT the L7 compute-equivalent Pareto result (still cloud-blocked).
